title: Design System: TV × Claude Intraday MCP

symbol.purpose: The active ticker read-out — the single largest element on screen.

title.purpose: Card and section headings, each trailed by a muted method sub-label.

body.purpose: Default reading text, disclosure prose, list items.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels: tile keys, section eyebrows, badges.

shadows.name: floating-overlay
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system — reserved for the autocomplete dropdown and any UI that truly floats above the document.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Standard easing for the few state transitions the terminal uses (border/opacity on hover, focus). Motion stays minimal by design.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/focus border and opacity shifts. Instant enough to feel like hardware.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button; the affordance is the edge, not a color wash.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #1f2733; color: #d7dde6; border: 1px solid #272e3a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 11px; font: 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #3b82f6; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Live status chip; .ok/.bad follow the Meaning-Only color rule.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; background: #161b22; border: 1px solid #272e3a; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; color: #8b97a7; font: 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-ok { color: #26a17b; border-color: #1f3b30; } .ds-pill-bad { color: #e5534b; border-color: #3b2422; }

components.name: Nav Tab (active)
components.description: Tab nav; active tab reads as a raised chip of the page surface.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #8b97a7; border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 12px; font: 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #d7dde6; } .ds-tab-active { background: #161b22; border-color: #272e3a; color: #d7dde6; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Symbol combobox field; focus is a calm translucent-blue border, not a glow.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search a symbol — e.g. RELIANCE, INFY, AAPL" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0f141b; border: 1px solid #272e3a; border-radius: 6px; color: #d7dde6; font: 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 5px 10px; min-width: 260px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8b97a7; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(76,141,255,0.47); }

components.name: Decision Tile
components.description: Instrument-cluster tile: uppercase key over a value, with good/bad/warn variants.
components.css: .ds-tile { background: #0f141b; border: 1px solid #272e3a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 9px; min-width: 150px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile-k { color: #8b97a7; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 3px; } .ds-tile-v { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #d7dde6; } .ds-tile-good { border-color: #1f3b30; } .ds-tile-good .ds-tile-v { color: #26a17b; } .ds-tile-bad { border-color: #3b2422; } .ds-tile-bad .ds-tile-v { color: #e5534b; } .ds-tile-warn { border-color: #3a3115; } .ds-tile-warn .ds-tile-v { color: #d9a441; }

components.name: Signal State Badge
components.description: Signature component: the plan's live state encoded as fill+text; the state is the instruction.
components.html: VALID ARMED EXTENDED INVALID EXPIRED
components.css: .ds-st { padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 11px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-st-valid { background: #10261f; color: #26a17b; } .ds-st-armed { background: #1c2740; color: #3b82f6; } .ds-st-ext { background: #2a2410; color: #d9a441; } .ds-st-invalid { background: #2a1716; color: #e5534b; } .ds-st-expired { background: #20242c; color: #8b97a7; }

components.name: How-It-Works Disclosure
components.description: Signature component: methodology + honest caveat, one click away. The Analyst's Desk made literal.
components.html:
How it works

Stage 1 scans the whole NSE universe server-side and scores each name. Only high-quality setups are shown.

Honest caveat: Stage 1 is profile-informed from day-level data; use Confirm for true on-chart levels.
components.css: .ds-how { border: 1px solid #272e3a; border-radius: 8px; background: #0f141b; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-how > summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; color: #d7dde6; list-style: none; } .ds-how > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-how > summary::before { content: '▸ '; color: #8b97a7; } .ds-how[open] > summary::before { content: '▾ '; } .ds-how-body { padding: 2px 14px 12px; border-top: 1px solid #272e3a; } .ds-how-body p { margin: 8px 0; color: #8b97a7; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-how-note { border-top: 1px dashed #272e3a; padding-top: 8px; }

narrative.overview: A professional-grade trading instrument that never lies. The surface is dark, dense, and information-first — the calm authority of a Bloomberg-class cockpit, where numbers are the hero and chrome gets out of the way. Every panel is a rectangle of near-black glass with a single hairline edge; the four signal colors flare only when the market means something. Tempering that terminal severity is the Analyst's Desk: the system shows its work — every analysis surface carries a 'How it works' disclosure, jargon has a glossary, and a missing data source renders an honest 'no data' rather than an invented number. Dense and legible to a newcomer at the same time.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal terminal: four stacked greys carry all structure; four signal colors carry all meaning.
Hairline, not shadow — 1px borders define every surface; depth is tonal.
Tabular by nature — monospaced, right-aligned, tnum numerics that don't jitter as they tick.
Self-documenting — 'How it works' disclosures and honest empty states are first-class components.
High density, high legibility — a pro tool a newcomer can still read.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Green, red, amber and blue are reserved for market meaning — bullish, bearish, caution, interactive. If something is colored, it is because it carries state. Never use a signal color for decoration. The rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces get darker as they recede (terminal-ink → panel → inset → well). The greys and the hairline do the structural work, keeping the four signal colors rare and legible.

rules.name: The Soft-White Rule
rules.body: Primary text is #d7dde6, never #ffffff. Pure white on near-black vibrates; the off-white reads calmer over a long session.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every price, level, ratio and countdown uses tabular-nums or the mono data font. Digits align in tables and never shift width as a live value ticks.

rules.name: The Method-in-the-Subhead Rule
rules.body: A section title states what; its muted small sub-label states how. The method is always one glance away.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces cast no shadow. A shadow is permitted only on UI that truly floats above the document. In the layout: a hairline, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: One border weight system-wide: 1px, #272e3a. Structure is drawn with light, even lines — never with weight, color, or shadow.

dos: Do keep every color strictly semantic — green/red/amber = market state, blue = interactive.
Do render all numeric data with tabular-nums or the mono data font, so live values align and never jitter.
Do convey depth with the four-grey tonal stack + 1px hairlines; keep resting surfaces flat.
Do pair every analysis surface with a 'How it works' disclosure and an honest empty / 'no data' state.
Do right-align numeric table columns and left-align labels; keep tables horizontally scrollable rather than shrinking the type.
Do use soft off-white #d7dde6 for primary text, never pure white.
donts: Don't introduce a decorative or brand accent color; there is no non-semantic hue in this system.
Don't put drop shadows on resting cards, tiles, or badges — shadow is reserved for truly floating overlays.
Don't fabricate numbers, states, testimonials, or performance to fill a panel — a truthful 'no data' is the correct design.
Don't let primary text or state colors fall below WCAG AA contrast on panel/terminal-ink.
Don't widen the container past ~1280px or trade the tabular density for marketing whitespace — this is an instrument, not a landing page.
